misses.what: Magic-link sign-in now needs an extra click: the emailed link opens a page with a 'Continue to BottleCRM' button and only the button press signs in (fixes mail scanners like Defender Safe Links using up the one-time link and leaving users with 'Link expired or invalid').

Audit log entries (sign-in, logout, org switch) and estimate acceptance records now store the visitor's real browser User-Agent instead of the server's 'axios' UA, when RELAY_SECRET is configured on both frontend and API.
